title: Big Cornish and little Dad fight stories
summary: Banjo and guitar remarks, and the comic fights between tall Cornish and tiny Dad, who ran between his legs.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: What about that fight between Big Cornish and Dad? You tell me about that once. Oh I'll tell you about Cornish and Dad.

And I'll tell you about Conius II. Conius II was another guy who had a fight. I didn't laugh at him, that you know, and he was playing gettoes them day. You see, gettoes started out in Dixieland, you know. And then the banjo took off, but getto was the first, you know. But he got the banjo because getto was in there to improvise then. The gipho was too soft, you know. That's when the banjo would come in. Well Cornish and Dad was a little bit of a fellow, you know. Oh, Cornish is about seven feet, you know. And Dad was a little old fellow about three feet high, probably three feet I guess. So when they'd get tight, you know, both of them would always like to fight with one another, you know. But Cornish would be playing with him, you know, and Dad would be hit, Cornish would hit at Dad, you know, and Dad would run between Cornish's legs. Dad would run between Cornish's legs.
